ORIGIN.quote: This is consistent with hosted/production AI-agent services running on Azure compute (e.g., agentic products built on Azure OpenAI or similar), rather than residential users.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away seeing dozens of OpenAI/ChatGPT/OAI-bearing usernames reproduced in timelines and tables, plus Azure hosting, but the report never treats any of this as evidence about who operated the swarm — the OpenAI-bearing labels are instead interpreted as generic "scenario personas," and the only origin-framing mention of OpenAI is a hedged aside about Azure compute possibly running "Azure OpenAI or similar" model services. It stays below the 0.4 band because OpenAI is never raised as a candidate operator and then set aside; the explicit attribution discussion in the confidence summary asks whether "any single organization/operator is responsible" without ever naming OpenAI, and leans toward many unrelated deployments, so the reader must make the connection unaided.
